refined_requirement: The system shall automatically reorder items when the stock level falls below 10% of the maximum allowed quantity. Reordering shall occur within a maximum of 2 hours to avoid stockouts. The solution must be capable of handling at least 1000 SKUs without significant performance degradation. Notifications for failed reorders must be sent within 30 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: The system automatically reorders items when the stock level falls below 10% of the maximum allowed quantity.
